title: Data Platform Engineer I
description:

title: Senior Data Engineer - Real time analytics
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.
 We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.
 As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your Contribution Are you passionate about building robust data pipelines and enabling data-driven innovation? As a Data Engineer, you will design and evolve scalable data platforms that power analytics, machine learning, and business insights across DISH. Working closely with product teams, data scientists, analysts, and engineers, you will help shape our data ecosystem and contribute to the digital transformation of the HoReCa industry.
 Menu of Responsibilities This role is part of our Data Insights Team, consisting of three Centers of Excellence (CoEs) and one Platform Team. You will be responsible for: Designing, building, and operating scalable data platforms and pipelines that support analytics, AI, and business decision-making. Delivering data products within cross-functional squads and translating business needs into reliable, cost-efficient solutions. Developing and maintaining batch and real-time data processing solutions on Google Cloud using modern ETL/ELT practices. Establishing data engineering standards, guardrails, and best practices that enable safe experimentation while protecting production environments. Enabling AI and machine learning initiatives through the adoption of Vertex AI, Model Garden, and GenAI orchestration frameworks. Developing integrations, APIs, and workflow orchestration processes to ensure reliable and scalable data movement across systems.
 Ingredients for Success Proven experience designing and operating distributed data systems and processing large-scale datasets. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with working knowledge of Java and software engineering best practices. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud technologies, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub. Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using tools such as DBT, Airflow, Spark, and API-based integrations.  As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own meaningful parts of a large-scale, mission-critical processing platform — driving architectural improvements, building new billing capabilities, and maintaining the high reliability bar our downstream consumers depend on.
